# Implementation Plan: Raise codex-exec.mjs default timeout & re-validate its premise

<!-- ralph-meta {"overviewTaskId":"ralph-codex-exec-default-timeout-too-short"} -->

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph` on 2026-06-08. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan .ralph/jobs/ralph-codex-exec-default-timeout-too-short/plan.md`.*

## Overview

`plugins/ralph/src/codex-exec.mjs` self-reaps a codex run at `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS =
240000` (4 min). That default is too short: it prematurely reaps healthy long
`xhigh` codex lens runs, surfacing to the operator as bogus exit-124 "stalls."
The operator hard-minimum is 20 min. This plan raises the default to **1200000
(20 min)**, reframes the wrapper timeout as a pure LAST-RESORT backstop for a
genuinely-wedged codex (the real pipe-deadlock was already fixed in v5.54.0 by the
fd-backed concurrent drain + tree-kill), re-validates and corrects the stale
"must self-reap below a ~300s harness tool-timeout" premise in the module comment,
adds a hermetic regression-guard test pinning the new default, and ships the
standard ralph 6-stamp version bump + CHANGELOG + AGENTS.md docs.

This is a SUBMODULE task (`ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/ralph`): implement on a
topic branch in a submodule worktree, two-commit flow (submodule commit first,
then the codexu pointer bump), and the lead pauses before the version push.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context
(Full detail in `research-brief.md`.)
- **`DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 240000`** at `src/codex-exec.mjs:72` is the sole constant
  to raise. `SNAPSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000` (:75) and `TIMEOUT_EXIT_CODE = 124` (:79)
  are nearby but VALUE-unchanged.
- **`resolveTimeoutMs` (:391-402)** precedence `--timeout-ms` > `CODEX_EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS`
  > `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS`; the `0`/negative = disabled semantics live in
  `waitForChild` (:451 `if (timeoutMs > 0)`). All of this is preserved.
- **Every in-repo caller inherits the default** — none passes `--timeout-ms`:
  `src/ralph.mjs` (per-iteration codex implementer), `src/review-loop.mjs`
  (planning-engine codex path :823 + 3-way re-review codex slot :1072), and all
  research/review SKILL prose. Raising the default helps every inheriting caller
  **on engines/wrappers that do not enforce an outer shell-tool timeout** —
  Copilot CLI (the operator's engine) backgrounds async commands with no hard kill,
  and the `ralph.mjs` iteration-engine + `review-loop.mjs` paths spawn codex-exec
  with no outer timeout at all. CAVEAT (corroborated by the codex reviewer): under
  Claude Code the research/review SKILLs still wrap the codex-exec call in a Bash
  tool `timeout: 300000` (`skills/brainstorm-with-ralph`, `skills/plan-with-ralph`,
  `skills/multi-model-investigate`, `skills/review-changes`), which can hard-kill a
  healthy run at 5 min BEFORE codex-exec reaches its new 20-min default. So the
  raise FULLY helps the iteration-engine + review-loop paths and the operator's
  Copilot-CLI lenses; it only PARTIALLY helps Claude-Code SKILL lenses until those
  outer Bash timeouts are also raised (see Open Questions).
- **Tests do not pin `240000`** (`tests/test-codex-exec.mjs` passes explicit
  `--timeout-ms 1000`/`0`; grep for `240000` in tests = 0 hits). The default path is
  exercised but its value is never asserted, so the bump is test-safe. The
  `main(argv, opts)` injectable surface (injected `setTimeout: (fn, delay) => ...`,
  :299) makes a value-pinning regression test trivial.
- **6 version stamps currently `5.54.0`** -> bump to `5.55.0`. CHANGELOG head is
  `## v5.54.0`.

### Technical Constraints
- **Premise re-validation (load-bearing).** The "~300s harness tool-timeout" the
  comment cites is the `timeout: 300000` the SKILL prose passes to the Bash/shell
  TOOL that invokes codex-exec — not a property of codex-exec. Findings:
  - **Copilot CLI** (operator engine): async shell commands BACKGROUND with **no
    300s hard kill** (`initial_wait` 30-600s then background; async runs
    indefinitely). A 240s self-reap therefore prematurely reaps healthy long runs.
  - **Claude Code**: the Bash `timeout` IS a hard kill at the specified value, so a
    SKILL passing `timeout: 300000` kills node at 300s. This is now redundant
    because (a) the v5.54.0 SIGINT/SIGTERM signal handlers run the same
    snapshot+tree-kill on ANY harness kill, and (b) the pipe-deadlock root cause is
    fixed, so healthy long runs no longer hang.
  - **Therefore** the under-300s constraint is engine-specific + obsolete; reframe
    the timeout as a last-resort backstop and raise it. Orphan-prevention is
    engine-honest: under Copilot CLI (operator engine) there is no harness hard-kill
    so there is no regression; under Claude Code a harness SIGTERM is caught by the
    v5.54.0 SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers (snapshot + tree-kill, no orphan), and only an
    immediate uncatchable SIGKILL would bypass them — a narrow, pre-existing window
    independent of this constant, best closed by raising the SKILL Bash timeout
    (Open Questions).
- **SNAPSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS interaction:** value (8000) unchanged. Its purpose (bound
  the pre-kill snapshot so the reap path completes promptly) is independent of the
  self-reap value; only its stale "stays well under ~300s harness bound"
  justification comment is corrected.

## Approach

### Architecture
A near-surgical change: one constant value + the comment block that documents the
(now-corrected) design rationale around it, plus a regression-guard test and the
mandatory release bookkeeping. No control-flow, no signature, no caller changes.

### Implementation Strategy
1. Raise the constant + rewrite the premise/header comment + correct the
   SNAPSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS justification (US-001).
2. Add the hermetic default-value regression-guard test (US-002).
3. Version bump (6 stamps) + CHANGELOG v5.55.0 + AGENTS.md v5.55.0 docs (US-003).

All three touch the SAME plugin, so they run as ONE impl member (serial), not in
parallel.

### Files to Create/Modify
- **Modify** `plugins/ralph/src/codex-exec.mjs`:
  - Line 72: `const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 240000;` -> `1200000` (with an inline
    `// 20 min` note + a brief "last-resort backstop; overridable; 0 disables" hint).
  - Lines ~18-21 (file-top block) and 66-71 (constant comment): replace the "must
    self-reap BELOW the caller's harness tool-timeout (~300s) ... default leaves
    comfortable headroom under 300s" framing with the corrected premise: the timeout
    is a last-resort backstop for a genuinely-wedged codex; the pipe-deadlock root
    cause is fixed (fd-backed drain) and orphan-prevention on a harness kill is
    handled by the SIGINT/SIGTERM signal handlers, so the default no longer needs to
    sit under any harness bound. Keep the `--timeout-ms` / `CODEX_EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS` /
    `0`-disables documentation accurate.
  - Lines 73-75: correct the `SNAPSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS` comment so it justifies the cap
    as "bound the pre-kill snapshot so the reap path completes promptly" rather than
    "stays well under the ~300s harness bound." VALUE unchanged.
- **Modify** `plugins/ralph/tests/test-codex-exec.mjs`: add one `test(...)` that
  calls `main(["--prompt", promptFile, "--output", outputFile], {...})` with NO
  `--timeout-ms` and an env WITHOUT `CODEX_EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS`, injecting
  `setTimeout: (fn, delay) => { captured = delay; return 1; }` plus a spawn whose
  child never closes. CRITICAL (consensus reviewer finding): `main()` awaits
  `waitForChild()`, so the test MUST settle the promise — after the synchronous
  `setTimeout` capture, invoke the captured timeout callback (so `waitForChild`
  settles to `124`), then `await` the promise and assert the captured delay
  `=== 1200000` (and, optionally, the resolved code `=== 124`). This mirrors the
  existing "wrapper timeout ... returns 124" test and avoids an unresolved-promise
  hang. Pins the operator hard-minimum so a future edit cannot silently lower it.
- **Modify** `plugins/ralph/CHANGELOG.md`: prepend a `## v5.55.0` entry. Do NOT edit
  the historical `## v5.54.0` block. The entry must NARROW the guarantee to the
  codex-exec wrapper default and note that outer shell-tool timeouts (Claude-Code
  SKILL `timeout: 300000`) may still cap a run before the new default is reached.
- **Modify** `plugins/ralph/AGENTS.md`: add a `## v5.55.0 Behavioral Additions`
  section (with the same narrowed-guarantee note); refresh the "Six version stamps
  in sync" line to `5.55.0`; refresh any present-tense mention of the `240000`
  default. Leave the historical `## v5.54.0 Behavioral Additions` section intact
  (docs convention: versioned sections document shipped behavior at the time).
- **Modify** the 6 version stamps (ralph entry only) to `5.55.0`:
  `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.github/plugin/marketplace.json`,
  `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`, `plugins/ralph/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`,
  `plugins/ralph/.github/plugin/plugin.json`, `plugins/ralph/.codex-plugin/plugin.json`.

## Scope

### In Scope
- Raise `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS` to `1200000`.
- Rewrite the premise/header comment + correct the SNAPSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS comment.
- Add a regression-guard test for the new default.
- Preserve `--timeout-ms` / `CODEX_EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS` overrides + `0`/negative-disable.
- Standard 6-stamp version bump + CHANGELOG + AGENTS.md docs.

### Out of Scope
- The SKILL-prose Bash `timeout: 300000` wrapper values (related; see Open Questions).
- The codex iteration-engine runaway-Collab-spawn hang
  (`ralph-codex-iteration-engine-runaway-spawn-guard`) — a distinct pathology.
- copilot-exec read-only snapshot guard or any other codex-exec behavior.
- Touching `codex-lowering.mjs`'s unrelated `RECIPE_TIMEOUT_MS = 30000`
  (`wait_agent` recipe timeout, a different concept).

## Risk Areas
- **Low overall.** Single-constant value change + comment edits + one new test.
- **Comment accuracy** is the main quality risk: the rewrite must not leave any
  residual "under ~300s" claim in the file. Mitigation: grep the file for `300`
  after the edit.
- **Version-stamp completeness:** all 6 stamps must move together or CI invariants
  flag drift. Mitigation: grep all 6 for `5.55.0` after the edit; the AGENTS.md
  "Six version stamps in sync" line must read 5.55.0 too.
- **Wrong "version" field in the two installer indexes:** the top-level marketplace
  `version` (`1.0.0`) is NOT the ralph entry — edit the ralph plugin entry's
  `version`, not the index header.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS === 1200000` in `src/codex-exec.mjs`.
- `src/codex-exec.mjs` contains none of these premise phrases: `~300s`,
  `under 300s`, `harness tool-timeout`, `harness bound` (an unrelated bare numeric
  `300` elsewhere is acceptable only if it has nothing to do with the timeout
  premise).
- `--timeout-ms`, `CODEX_EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS`, and `0`/negative-disable semantics are
  unchanged (resolveTimeoutMs precedence + `waitForChild` `> 0` guard untouched).
- A new test in `tests/test-codex-exec.mjs` asserts the resolved default (no
  `--timeout-ms`, no `CODEX_EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS`) is `1200000` AND settles the awaited
  `main(...)` promise (capture the `setTimeout` delay, then invoke the captured
  timeout callback so the promise resolves to `124`; do NOT leave an unresolved
  promise); `node --test plugins/ralph/tests/test-codex-exec.mjs` passes green (all
  existing tests + the new one).
- All 6 version stamps read `5.55.0`; the AGENTS.md "Six version stamps in sync"
  line reads `5.55.0`.
- `CHANGELOG.md` gains a `## v5.55.0` entry describing the raise + premise
  correction; `## v5.54.0` is unmodified.
- `AGENTS.md` gains a `## v5.55.0 Behavioral Additions` section.
- The CHANGELOG v5.55.0 + AGENTS.md v5.55.0 text NARROWS the guarantee to the
  codex-exec wrapper default and notes that outer shell-tool timeouts (e.g.
  Claude-Code SKILL `timeout: 300000`) may still cap a run before the new default
  is reached.
- Release gates pass from the toolkit repo root:
  `node tools/validate-codex-marketplace-policy.mjs`; the Copilot gate
  `node plugins/ralph/scripts/generate-copilot-artifacts.mjs --check && node plugins/ralph/scripts/check-copilot-parity.mjs`;
  and the Codex gate
  `node plugins/ralph/scripts/generate-copilot-artifacts.mjs --target=codex --check && node plugins/ralph/tests/test-codex-generator.mjs`.

cluster, one impl member.

## Open Questions
- **SKILL-prose Bash `timeout: 300000` (Claude Code only).** Under Claude Code, a
  healthy codex run between 300s and 20 min would still be hard-killed by the Bash
  tool at 300s (independent of codex-exec's default). The operator runs Copilot CLI
  (no hard kill), so this is non-blocking for the operator. Whether to ALSO raise
  those SKILL Bash timeouts is a related follow-up — recommend filing
  `ralph-skill-bash-timeout-raise` separately rather than expanding this fix.
- **Exact value 20 vs 30 min.** Plan recommends 20 min (1200000) = the operator
  hard-minimum; 30 min (1800000) is a documented alternative left to overrides.

  124, then await + assert delay === 1200000), mirroring the existing timeout test.
- **F-002 [Medium, codex+claude]** — Overclaimed "helps all lenses simultaneously";
  Claude-Code SKILL `timeout: 300000` can still cap at 5 min. **Resolved:** narrowed

- **F-003 [Medium, claude]** — "No orphan regression" overclaim re: an uncatchable
  SIGKILL under Claude Code. **Resolved:** engine-honest wording (Copilot CLI no
  hard-kill; Claude Code SIGTERM caught by handlers; only immediate SIGKILL bypasses
  — a narrow pre-existing window independent of this constant).
- **F-004 [Medium, codex]** — Verification missing the Ralph Codex/Copilot
  release-gate checks. **Resolved:** US-003 ACs now require the Copilot gate and the

- **F-005 [Low, codex]** — "grep 300" AC too loose. **Resolved:** tightened to

  `harness bound`).
